verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM supports multiple workspaces that can each have distinct models, prompts, and custom agent skills (docs-9, docs-12, gh-1), which loosely maps to running multiple agents with their own configs, but there is no explicit documentation of routing conversations/channels to specific agents or managing distinct agent personas beyond per-workspace settings. missing for 10: explicit agent-routing/channel-assignment feature, evidence of multiple concurrent agents with distinct identities, independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
